text.aria-label: Subtitle text '6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 forecast runs on Tuesdays, July 2025 to June 2026; mean absolute error of the average of 51 ENS members, 3 seeds. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.5% interval (Bonferroni across the 10 contrasts) from re-drawing whole months. Dashed rule: same as the reference. Dotted rule: the smallest gain that counts (-0.15).'
text.tspan: 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 forecast runs on Tuesdays, July 2025 to June 2026; mean
absolute error of the average of 51 ENS members, 3 seeds.
Dot: estimate. Line: 99.5% interval (Bonferroni across the 10 contrasts) from re-drawing
whole months. Dashed rule: same as the reference. Dotted rule: the smallest gain that counts
